title: [BUG-FR10-04] Admin Web UI renders 'Đánh dấu Đã giao' action button for canceled orders
body: - Feature: FR-10 Order State Machine - Component: Frontend Admin frontend-admin/src/App.jsx (lines 862–869) - Severity: Medium - Priority: P2 - Related Test Case: FR10-DT-29 - GitHub Issue: https://github.com/hoangphi117/HW02/issues/11 #### Steps to Reproduce 1. Log in to Admin Web Portal (http://localhost:5174). 2. Open the "Quản lý đơn hàng" tab. 3. Locate an order with status `canceled`. 4. Inspect the action buttons rendered in the table row. #### Expected Result No action buttons should be rendered for orders in terminal states (`canceled` and `delivered`), per Spec R5 and GĐ08. #### Actual Result The UI explicitly renders a button labeled **"Đánh dấu Đã giao"** on `canceled` orders. Clicking this button triggers the API call that exploits BUG-FR10-01, moving a canceled order to delivered. #### Evidence
